bsdus pa'i/ /bla ma khyod la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /chos rnams kun gyi rin chen gter/ /dge 'dun thams cad 'dus pa'

tei:div.tei:p: bsdus pa'i/ /bla ma khyod la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// chos rnams kun gyi rin chen gter/ /dge 'dun thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ / dpal ldan bla ma de la 'dud/ khyod ni gdul bya smin bya'i phyir/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam pa lnga/ khyod kyi phung po rnam lngar ston/ /spyan sogs khyod kyi 'byung ba bzhi/ /sa yi snying po rdo rje 'chang*/ /nam mkha'i snying po spyan ras gzigs/ /'jam dbyangs sgrib pa rnam par sel/ /byams pa kun tu bzang po rnams

| | mgon po khyod kyi dbang po sogs/ /gshin rje gshed sogs khro bo bcu | | dpal ldan khyod kyi sku yi cha/ /gzugs sogs rdo rje lha mor ston/ /nyon mongs ye shes gnas ( ¡¶ lu ¡· tshogs ) gyur pa/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed kyis mkhyen | | thams cad spros pa'i phrin las kyis/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad sprul/ /gcig tu bsdus pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag rdo rje 'chang | | bag chags bcas pa'i sgrib kun spangs*/ /yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs pa/ khyod kyi phrin las ngo mtshar rmad/ /gang gis g.yo med khyod bsten pa || de la de ma thag byin rlobs/ /skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / yang na phun tshogs thams cad 'grub/ /des na rdo rje slob dpon mchog /dngos po kun gyis de la 'dud/ /rnam pa kun tu bdag skyabs mchi/ /phyi nang gsang ba de kho na/ /lus dang longs spyod 'brel ba dang*/ /srog gi bar gyis khyod mnyes bgyi/ /ji srid rnam par grol ba'i sa/ /bdag gzhan kun gyis ma thob par/ /de srid mchod pa mchog gi sprin/ /kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar las// ches lhag gyur pas khyod mchod do/ khyod ni gang la mnyes gyur pa'i/ /phrin las de nyid bsgrub par shog /mi mnyes byed pa rnam spangs te/ /rnam pa kun tu khyod bsten no/ khyod kyi phrin las bsgrub slad du/ /mgon po gang la mnyes gyur na/ / gal te bla na med pa yi/ /byang chub thob kyang de dor te/ /skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ khyod kyi phrin las bsgrub par bgyi/ /dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan kun | khyod mnyes bgyid pa'ang bsgrub par shog /bla ma dam pa la dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rten cing 'brel ba 'byung ba'i sgo nas bstod pa/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas sbyar ba'o/ /gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur phyin ci ma log par thob pa'i gang zag gis/

tshul 'di lta bu'i sgo nas bla ma la gsol ba btab na/ tshe 'di nyid la rdo rje 'chang chen po thob par 'gyur ro/ /dbang bskur ba yang dag par ma thob pa'i gang zag gis bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba gdab par ma mthong ngo*/ /dbang bskur ba yang dag par thob nas bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la tshul 'di lta bu'i sgo nas bstod na/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bstod par 'gyur bas rten 'brel thams cad rang 'grig tu 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin no/ / ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + theg pa chen po thun mong ma yin pa'i bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs pa zhes bya ba dpal sa skya paṇḍi tas legs par sbyar ba rdzogs so/ / ) ༄༅/ /gangs can gyi sgom chen rnams la gdams pa bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ gangs ri'i khrod 'dir sgom chen mang yod de/ / rab 'bring tha ma'i tshul du spring bar bya/ /de la log pa'i phyogs 'dzin spangs pa yi | | rab tu dad pa'i yid kyis gsan par zhu/ /lta ba spros bral rnam dag shugs 'chang lus/ /g.yeng med bsgom pa rnam dag yan lag ldan/ /spyod pa rnam dag g.yu yi ral pa can/ /seng ge gangs la gnas pa'i sgom chen yin/ / 'gro don dpag med go cha rab bgos te/ /tshogs gnyis rtar zhon brtson pa'i lcag gis bskul/ /shes rab mtshon gyis nyon mongs dgra tshogs 'joms/ / dpa' bo g.yul du zhugs pa'i sgom chen yin/ /dri med bslab gsum rin chen bang mdzod ldan/ /'gro la zang zing mi 'jigs sbyin gtong mdzad/ /dam chos sbyin pas thar lam 'dzud byed pa/ /bsdu bas gzhan don mdzad pa'i sgom chen yin | | de ltar sgom chen rab gsum bstan pa yi/ /snying po mchog tu gyur pa mkhyen mdzod cig/ //gdams pa rgya mtsho khong du ma chud kyang*/ /spyi bor bla ma bsgom zhing dad pa yis/ /mig nas mchi ma 'khrungs shing gsol 'debs pa/ /thar pa'i lam sna zin pa'i sgom chen yin/ /dmigs med lta bas 'ching ba ma grol yang*/

/rin chen byang chub sems kyis thugs rgyas te/ /gzhan don bsgrub la zhum pa mi mnga' ba/ /gzhan phan yid bzhin nor bu'i sgom chen yin/ /theg mchog bsgrub pa tshul bzhin ma nus kyang*/ /dbang bzhi'i dam tshig me tog chun po ni/ /mgo yi thod bzhin rab tu srung byed pa/ /srid pa myur du sgrol ba'i sgom chen yin/ / brtse bas gzhan don bsgrub pa'i sems med kyang*/ /dri med bka' dang dam pa'i gsung thos nas/ /blang dor rgyu dang 'bras bu lhur byed pa/ /ngan 'gro'i sgo 'phrang gcod pa'i sgom chen yin/ /de ltar de dag bstan pa'i sgo zhugs zhes/ /rtogs ldan skyes bu dag gis mkhyen par mdzod/ /rang nyid gang mos lam du zhugs pa dang | | gzhan la nges shes bskyed phyir blang bar mdzod// //dam pa'i gdams pas spros pa ma chod par/ /zhi gnas bying po gcig la sems bzung nas/ /gti mug mun pa yang yang spel byed pa/ /'phyi ba tshang du nyal ba'i sgom chen yin/ /dad dang 'dun pas sems rgyud ma thul bar/ / 'gran 'dod dben pa'i ri la brten byas te/ /'dod yon sgo kun rtag tu yid byed pa/ /gcan gzan ri la nyal ba'i sgom chen yin/ /thar pa'i lam dor nyes pa kun spel bas/ /bzang 'dod ri brag gnas pas dus 'das te/ /de rjes yon bdag pho mo'i grong chog mkhan/ /wa 'dra grong stong 'grim pa'i sgom chen yin | | chos grags 'dod pa rtswa yi me bzhin 'bar/ kha phyir kun tu rgyu ba'i brtson 'grus can/ /log pa'i 'tsho bas rtag tu 'tsho byed pa/ khyi rkun grong mtha' nyul pa'i sgom chen yin/ /rgyal po ngan pa'i tshul 'chang ngur smrig 'dzin/ /chags sdang mtshon thogs du ma'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /mi dge'i phrin las phyogs kun rgyas byed pa/ /ngan 'gro'i gnas gsum spel ba'i sgom chen yin/ /de ltar sgo gsum dge la gol ba yi/ /sdig byed 'di dag bstan pa'i chom rkun zhes/ / bstan pa'i sgor zhugs ston pa'i bya ba la/

/sdang bas log zhugs byed pa spang bar zhu/ /dri med bstan pa'i mkha' la gegs med par/ /shar ba'i lung rtogs dkyil 'khor rgyas pa can/ /legs bshad 'od kyis mdzes pa'i nyi ma des/ / gdul bya'i tshal ni dge bas rgyas gyur cig /zhes dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas/ ¡Ã byang phyogs 'ga'i yul nas ( ¡¶ lu ¡· - byang phyogs 'ga'i yul nas ) gangs can gyi sgom chen pa rnams la zhal ta byed pa'i tshigs su bcad pa'o// //maṅgalaṃ//༄༅/ /dpal gdong bzhi pa'i bstod pa bzhugs// ༄༅/ /na mo gu ra we/ dpal gdong bzhi pa'i mgon po la bstod pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan dbang ldan srid gsum dbang bsgyur zhing*/ /mche ba gtsigs shing mchu 'phyang shugs che ba/ /sgra sgrogs dril bu'i phreng bas brgyan pa yi/ /gzhon nu'i lus can 'gegs 'joms khyod la 'dud/ /du ma'i ming can drag po'i phreng ba can/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i mig gis bdud 'joms shing*/ /brkyang bskum glog stong 'gyu ba'i khro gnyer can/ /mdung thung gri gug bum thod 'dzin la bstod/ /'jigs byed myur 'gro tshangs skud mi mgo yi/ /phreng ba 'dzin cing sa gsum skrag byed pa'i/ /kṣiṃ kṣiṃ sgra sgrogs srin po'i gzugs 'dzin pa/ /dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba khyod la bstod/ /dpal ldan gru 'dzin chen po ni/ khyod bzhugs te se'i gangs ri na/ /gdong bzhi ldan khyod zhing skyong mdzad/ /kun srung khyod la bstod par bya/ /ha ha'i gad rgyangs 'brug sgra sgrogs/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ sgrogs pa'i dpal khyod kyis/ /srid gsum gnas pa'i bgegs rnams kun/ /skrag mdzad khyod la bstod par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan snga ru/ /dam bcas don de da lta 'dir/ /sgrub pos ( ¡¶ lu ¡· na ) thogs pa med gyur pa/ /dam tshig ldan khyod bstod par bya/ /sha chen zan dang me tog spos | | chang phud sha khrag la dga' ba/ khyod ni byang ( ¡¶ lu ¡· phyag ) na rab bzhugs shing

| | phyogs bcur dbang byed khyod la bstod/ /g.yung mo gtum mo srin mo dang | | siṅga lar gnas rnal 'byor ma/ /dmar dang ljang nag khros pa'i zhal/ / gri gug thod 'dzin bstod par bya/ khyod kyis rang phyogs legs srung zhing*/ / gzhan phyogs rnam par sun 'byin pa/ /don gnyis sgrub pa'i yab yum la/ / bdag gis rtag tu bstod par bya/ /de ltar bstod pas rab bsngags pas/ / bdag cag 'khor bcas bsrung ba dang*/ /'dod pa thams cad bsgrub pa dang*/ / dgra bgegs ma lus med par mdzod/ khyed kyis bsgrub pa'i las bya zhing*/ / rjes su bsgrub na brtse ba dang*/ /yongs su bsten na dgyes pa dang*/ /sun 'byin rnam par gzhom par mdzod/ /klog pa rnams ni rgyas pa dang*/ kha ton phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ /sgrub pa dri ma med pa dang*/ /bstan pa dag kyang dar bar mdzod | | mdor na gang dang gang bcol ba/ /de dang de yi las rnams la/ / btang snyoms g.yel ba ma mdzad par/ /bdag la rjes su brtse bar mdzod/ / dpal ldan gdong bzhi'i mgon po la bstod pa/ shākya'i dge bsnyen ( ¡¶ lu ¡· slong ) kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis sa skya'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// //༄༅/ /snang ba mtha' yas bsgom don bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i/ bdag ni 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa na/ /sgrib pa thams cad dag ni phyir bsal te/ /mngon sum snang ba mtha' yas de mthong nas/ /bde ba can gyi zhing der rab tu 'gro/ /der song nas ni smon lam 'di dag kyang*/ / thams cad ma lus mngon du 'gyur bar shog /ces gsungs pa la brten nas mdzad pa'i snang ba mtha' yas kyi bsgom don ni/ dgongs mo nyal ba'i dus su/ glo g.yas pa 'og tu bcug nas nyal la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ sa phyogs 'di bde ba can gyi zhing khams yin snyam du bsams la/ rang yi dam du bsgom | mdun du padma dang zla ba'i steng du snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar po phyag mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya'i steng na lhung bzed bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa

| zhabs skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa cig bsgom/ de'i mtha' ma na phar bla ma rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs par bsam | de'i phyi rol nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bskor ¡Ã nas bzhugs par ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· - nas bzhugs par ¡¶ lu ¡· + ba ) bsams la | yid kyis phyag gsum de rnams la btsal/ bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa'am/ de med na kho bos byas pa'i chos spyod bcu pa tshar gsum 'don | de nas dbugs phyir rgyu ba dang bstun la rang gi sems rgyal ba'i thugs kar thim nas rgyal ba'i thugs dang dbyer med du bsam/ dbugs nang du 'jug pa'i dus su rgyal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od byung bdag gi ngag gi lam nas zhugs nas snying gar thim pas rgyal ba'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med du bsam | de 'dra 'khor gsum byas pa'i tha ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams bla ma la thim/ bla ma rnams snang ba mtha' yas la thim/ snang ba mtha' yas 'od du zhu nas bdag la thim/ bdag kyang 'od du zhu nas der sangs rgyas yi dam rang sems gsum du ( ¡¶ lu ¡· - du ) dbyer med du 'dres par bsams la | smon lam 'di gdab/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der/ / padmo dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes/ /snang ba mtha' yas rgyal bas mngon sum du | | lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob shog /ces smon lam de btab la | dai'i ngang la yid gzhan du mi 'gyur bar gnyid log par bya'o/ /de ltar byas pas phyi ma la lus 'di/ sbrul shun pa brjes pa ltar bor nas nub phyogs bde ba can du padmo las brdzus te skyes nas snang ba mtha' yas las chos nyan par dkon mchog brtsegs pa las gsungs so/ /snang ba mtha' yas kyi bsgom don chos kyi rje sa skya paṇḍi tas mdzad pa'o// //༄༅/ /'chi kha ma'i gdams ngag ngo mtshar can bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/

/dang po dkon mchog gsum skyabs 'gro/ /de nas byang chub sems bsgom bya/ / mdun du snang ba mtha' yas bsgom/ /de la phyag 'tshal mchod pa bya/ /sbyor ¡Ã ba ( ¡¶ lu ¡· ba'i cho ga ) 'o/ /sdig pa dag pa'i nges shes bskyed/ /zhen pa thams cad gtang bar bya/ /'chi la 'jigs pa med sems kyis/ /snang ba mtha' yas ting 'dzin bsgrub/ /dngos gzhi'o/ /phyi nas rang gi lus la bsdu/ /bdag nyid de yi ngo bor bskyed/ /dge ba sems can rnams la bsngau/ /phyis kyang de la goms par bya/ /mjug go /de la nad dang gdon mi 'byung*/ /'chi ba'i dus na sdug bsngal med/ /bar dor thub pas rjes su 'dzin/ /phyi ma'i dus su thar pa thob | | phan yon no/ /'chi ka ma'i gdams ngag ngo mtshar can/ bla ma rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi gsung bzhin/ dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas yi ge nyung ngur bkod pa'o// // chos rje sa paṇa gsung rab dpe bsdur ma pod gnyis pa/ mel po'i shul bzhag las/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ PAGE 326PAGE 327
